title: Multimodal Reference Subtraction, Drone Voiceprint and Three-Dimensional Sound Meter for Drone Localization
description: Python package for offline 3D acoustic localization of drones with a six-microphone rigid spherical array (D = 160 mm): rigid-sphere sensor model with hardware errors, reference subtraction, drone voiceprint classification, sphere-steered harmonic SRP-PHAT, Kalman tracking, and an active mode with rotor silence windows. Includes the evaluation on the real in-flight DREGON recordings, a network-blocked (offline) run with timing, the Arabic hardware guide, and the submission package for Applied Acoustics.
